text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the Mainichi Okan,<n>where Grass
Wonder is set to face<n>both Silence Suzuka and El
Condor<n>Pasa.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The showdown of the century against<n>the
Otherworldly Front-Runner and the<n>Phantom Bird.
This is Grass<n>Wonder's chance to surpass them
both.
